{"metadata":{"description":"Preflight, test, release and hot-reload DeepSeek Harness plugins: one CLI, 34 tests, real output in the README.","id":"gh:1439910744","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-toolkit","slug":"WJDdidi-1/dsh-plugin-toolkit","topics":["cli","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","hot-reload","nodejs","plugin-testing","plugin-tooling","preflight","release-automation"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Preflight, test, release and hot-reload DeepSeek Harness plugins: one CLI, 34 tests, real output in "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"test, release and hot-reload DeepSeek Harness plugins: one CLI, 34 tests, real output in the README."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-toolkit"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English · 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Everything a DeepSeek Harness plugin needs between `init` and a version the market index accepts: sc"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"affolding, a test harness for the client bundle, a way to see a change without restarting the app, a"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"nd a release that does not depend on remembering fourteen steps."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What `verify` actually does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The order matters. Packing first means the check reads the file list npm will publish, not the folde"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"r you have. Installing the tarball means the root export is imported the way the loader imports it. "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"Mounting means the client bundle is actually executed, in jsdom, with a host that records what it re"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"means the client bundle is actually executed, in jsdom, with a host that records what it registered."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Each step exists because a plugin once got past the step before it and still installed into nothing."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Releasing one plugin fifteen times taught me three things the ecosystem's tooling does not cover:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"1. **A version is not shipped when npm accepts it.** Registry propagation took two to eight minutes "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"every time. `npm view` answered from a stale local cache, so I repeatedly believed a release had fai"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"led when it had not — and once believed it had succeeded when the market still could not see it.
2. "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"**The market index is a second release, done by hand.** Each version needs an entry carrying `publis"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"hTimestamp` from the registry and `engines.dsh` from the manifest. Forget the range and the index va"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"lidator rejects the PR with `Engines mismatch` — after the tag is already public.
3. **Reading a man"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"ifest is not the same as checking it.** A plugin can have a valid `package.json` and still be uninst"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"allable: `files` that omit the entry the manifest points at, a bundle patch that does not exist, a R"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"EADME that never states the host range it declares."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The five failures behind these checks — a red dot with no panel, a row the host drops, an app that d"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"isables every plugin after one unguarded `apply()`, a tab nothing can open, and a checker that was w"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"rong — are written up with their exact error text and how to reproduce each one: Five plugins that i"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"nstalled and did nothing."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Node.js 18 or newer (the registry is read with `fetch`; no runtime dependencies)
- Git and `gh` on"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" `PATH` for the steps that touch GitHub
- DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0` — the version whose market inde"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"x carries `engines.dsh`, which is what makes the range check meaningful
- For `testkit`: `jsdom`, `r"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"eact` and `react-dom` as dev dependencies (`npm install --save-dev jsdom react react-dom`)"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### Check what assistive tech sees"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"`expectAria()` compares the attributes a screen reader actually reads — `role`,
`label`, `live`, `se"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"lected`, `expanded`, `checked`, `pressed`, `disabled` — and
names the one that differs:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"A missing attribute is reported as `nothing`, not as an empty string, because
those are different bu"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"gs. `panel.aria(selector)` returns the same object when you
want to assert on it yourself."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`must()` throws with the rendered markup when the selector misses, which is the difference between ""},{"id":"p20s2","text":"the assertion failed" and "here is what the user actually got"."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Every example below is a file in this repository, run by CI, and the output shown is the output it p"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"example below is a file in this repository, run by CI, and the output shown is the output it prints:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Example | What it shows |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| `node examples/mount-a-bundle.mjs` | mount a real bundle, read the text, click, read it again |
| "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"`node examples/route-stubs.mjs` | answer the routes a panel asks for, and assert on the requests |
|"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" `node examples/baseline.mjs` | a DOM baseline compared on every run |
| `node examples/aria.mjs` | "},{"id":"p23s4","text":"what assistive tech sees |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"To look at a bundle by hand:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"That is how the AIignore panel was checked before release: the real bundle, mounted in Node, against"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" a stubbed `/aiignore/*`:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## See what is installed, and what the app loaded"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"`doctor` checks one folder you name. The question that actually gets asked is
"why is my plugin not "},{"id":"p31s2","text":"in the sidebar?", and the answer needs three things at once:
what is installed, whether each install"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ed copy is valid, and which of them the
running app actually loaded."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":""Not loaded" has three different causes, and `audit` names the one that applies
instead of offering "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"hree different causes, and `audit` names the one that applies
instead of offering a blanket restart:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **Not in `dsh.profile.bundles`.** `pnpm add` (or `npm install`) installs the
package but does not "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"tell the loader to mount it. Add the package name to
`dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<prof"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"ile>/package.json`, or run
`dsh plugin add <name>`, then restart the app.
- **No `dsh.bundle`.** The"},{"id":"p34s4","text":" package declares `dsh` but no patch file to mount.
Add `dsh.bundle.patch` to its `package.json` and"},{"id":"p34s5","text":" ship the patch file, then
reinstall.
- **Listed, but the app predates the install.** The profile is"},{"id":"p34s6","text":" already correct;
restart the app once to read the new list."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Advisories (`engines.dsh`, README Requirements) are counted apart from problems:
the market index ne"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"eds them, the loader does not, so they should not bury a plugin
that is actually broken."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"`audit` exits `1` when an installed plugin has a hard failure **or** when the
running app did not lo"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"ad at least one installed plugin, so CI can gate on a
profile where the app silently skipped a plugi"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"n. It exits `0` when every
installed plugin is loaded and valid. If no graph was read (`--host` omit"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"ted),
the loaded column is `?` and only hard failures change the exit code."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Without `--host` the loaded column is `?`, because guessing would be worse than
saying nothing. Only"},{"id":"p37s2","text":" packages that declare a `dsh` field are audited — the rest of
`node_modules` is ordinary dependenci"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"es, and auditing those is noise."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"An installed package whose `package.json` cannot be read is the exception: the
`dsh` field that woul"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"d mark it as a plugin is in the file that failed to parse.
